entity_name: Bhubaneswar Urban Mo Bus Network Stops
claim: BhubaneswarOne UpdatedBusStops FeatureServer exposes 394 official bus stop assets with WGS84 point coordinates in Bhubaneswar Municipal/BDA boundary.
cross_thread_support: Cross-validated by Lead and Provenance Researcher (institutional provenance BSCL/BDA/BMC/CRUT).
limitations: 394 physical GIS features represent physical infrastructure (shelters, bays, directional poles), NOT 394 unique canonical stop identities.

Canonical promotion requires explicit 1-to-1 or N-to-1 identity crosswalk mapping against stops.json.
